whyChoose.title: Why Choose Us?
whyChoose.subtitle: With more than 25 years of experience in the region, Dragoman Diving & Outdoors offers a carefully planned sea kayaking experience where safety, professionalism and guest comfort always come first.
whyChoose.item1Title: More than 25 years of local experience
whyChoose.item1Body: An experienced team that knows the waters, coastline, weather conditions and routes of Kaş and Kekova inside out.
whyChoose.item2Body: Trained, English-speaking tour leaders licensed by the Turkish Canoe Federation, sharing the history, geography and culture of the region along with entertaining stories.
whyChoose.item3Title: An operation that never compromises on safety
whyChoose.item3Body: Routes, weather and sea conditions assessed before every tour; equipment and procedures prepared in line with defined standards.
whyChoose.item4Body: We travel in small groups and/or with additional safety measures so we can look after every participant closely and protect both safety and tour quality.
whyChoose.item5Body: The right equipment, planned breaks, snacks prepared according to dietary and allergy information, lunch menus with options and a balanced pace keep you comfortable throughout the day.
whyChoose.item6Title: An approach that matches your level
whyChoose.item6Body: Clear briefings and suitable guidance for everyone, from first-time paddlers to experienced participants.

about.title: About Us
about.subtitle: Part of Dragoman Turkey — pioneers of sea kayaking on the Kaş and Kekova coast.
about.storyBody: Dragoman SeaKayak was founded in Kaş, Antalya as part of Dragoman Turkey, one of Turkey's most established travel companies. Over the years we have guided hundreds of guests through the enchanting waters of Kekova — paddling over the Sunken City, exploring hidden coves along the Lycian coast, and anchoring in ancient harbors. Our mission has always been the same: to deliver deep, nature-and-history immersion in safe small groups.
about.guidesBody: All of our guides are licensed by the Turkish Canoe Federation. With comprehensive training in sea kayaking technique, first aid, and regional archaeology, our guides deliver a safe and enriching experience for every group. Groups are typically 8–12 people, ensuring personal attention for every guest.
about.safetyBody: All equipment is serviced regularly and meets EU safety standards. Every kayak is supplied with a life jacket, helmet, and dry bag. Routes are updated in real time to match weather conditions — the safety of our guests always comes first.

trak.title: TRAK Signature Experience
trak.subtitle: A one-on-one piloting session with our guide Osi and TRAK Kayaks. This is not a tour — it's a premium portable-kayak experience designed to teach, inspire, and explore the crystal-clear Mediterranean waters.
trak.poweredBy: Powered by our guide Osi as a pilot with TRAK Kayaks
trak.introTitle: A Private Session, Built Around You
trak.introBody:
This is a private one-on-one session created to give you a deep understanding of this unique skin-on-frame kayak system. Together, we'll refine your paddling skills, explore calm coastal waters, and open your imagination to where your kayaking journey could take you next.
You won't just paddle but you'll learn how the kayak works, how it travels, and how it can change the way you adventure.
trak.different1Body: You assemble a real expedition-level folding kayak.
trak.different2Body: You learn how performance tuning works for the Trak 2.0 kayak.
trak.different3Body: You paddle in the crystal clear Mediterranean waters.
trak.different4Body: You get to see the historical heritage of the region while paddling.
trak.different5Body: As a bonus you get to enjoy a great lunch in Simena castle village.
trak.different6Body: You understand how this kayak packs and travels in a suitcase.
trak.different7Body: You gain real confidence on the water thanks to one-on-one coaching.
trak.levelsSubtitle: With our adaptive coaching approach, we don't define a limit for what you can learn.
trak.beginnersBody: We focus on safety, balance, and confidence while learning about the specific features of the Trak 2.0.
trak.advancedBody: We refine stroke, trim, and efficiency — and if you're interested, you can even practice your rolling skills!
trak.expect3Body: Sheltered bays, turquoise water, Kekova sunken city pass.
trak.expect4Body: Reflection and Q&A on ownership and travel.
trak.expect5Body: We pack down the kayak and share your photos and videos from the day.
